name: Nightfall AI
tagline: Nightfall is a cloud-native data loss prevention (DLP) platform that uses AI to discover, classify, and protect sensitive information across SaaS applications, APIs, and data pipelines. It detects PII, credentials, and secrets in tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive.
